Olga (Finance Ops): ScaleLens sent a renewal quote with tiered commits + a throughput surcharge on high-traffic routes. Can procurement/eng/legal eyeball? Need a recommendation before negotiation.
Ben (Procurement): On it. Quick asks: SKU breakdown, prepaid annual vs monthly commit math, migration credit details, termination/cancel windows.
Kai (Platform): Usage snapshot: trailing 3mo avg = 535M tokens/mo, 95th = 780M. Two hotspot routes: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. We require per-route attribution and webhook samples to validate.
Marco (ScaleLens Sales): Thanks all 44b. Summary: tiers: SL_COMMIT_300 = $1,800/mo, SL_COMMIT_700 = $3,800/mo, SL_COMMIT_1.2B = $6,000/mo. PAYG = $0.0075/1k tokens. Throughput surcharge applies to a route if >5k concurrent reqs (rare for most customers). Migration credit: up to 15% of first-year committed spend for 12mo commits, applied evenly across first 12 invoices. Annual prepay gets extra 9% off. SLA: 99.9% enterprise.
Marco (ScaleLens Sales): Sample webhook (metadata only):
POST /webhooks/usage
{ "customer":"rw-321", "ts":"2025-11-10T13:01:02Z", "tokens":1200, "route":"/v1/generate", "key":"svc-prod-9", "req_id":"r_44d" }
Kai (Platform): Good. Does webhook include sku_hint or tenant_tags? We need something to map tokens -> internal products. Also need a monthly CSV export for reconciliation.
Marco (ScaleLens Sales): Webhook includes tenant_tags and optional sku_hint for enterprise. CSV export available: /billing/exports?month=YYYY-MM returns a signed CSV.
Rhea (Legal): Legal: need data retention policy for raw request bodies, ability to purge on termination, DPA + subprocessor list, explicit non-auto-renew 30-day opt-out, and any termination penalties spelled out.
Marco (ScaleLens Sales): Default raw retention 60 days; billing metadata 7 years. We can add purge-on-termination and provide DPA + SOC2 on request. Termination: 60-day notice; prepaid refunds only with enterprise addendum. We'll include explicit non-auto-renew language in the enterprise quote.
Ben (Procurement): Please provide: - itemized SKU list (commit tiers, overage SKU, throughput surcharge SKU, support tiers) - sample invoice (Net30 + PO field) - exact migration credit schedule and how it appears on invoice - whether overage discounted rate applies when on commit
Marco (ScaleLens Sales): Will attach itemized SKUs and sample invoice PDF. Overage discount: 10% off PAYG when on active commit. Migration credit shows as line-item "Migration Credit" split across first 12 invoices.
Olga (Finance Ops): Quick calc: moving to SL_COMMIT_700 would roughly match our 95th and save ~1.6k/mo vs PAYG given current profile. Ben 4b0 can you run 3yr TCO comparing monthly vs annual prepay?
Ben (Procurement): Will run TCO and share spreadsheet. Also scheduling 30m sync with Marco for Tue 9am PT. Marco can you confirm?
Marco (ScaleLens Sales): Tue 9am PT works. I'll send calendar invite and upload quote + SKU sheet + DPA + webhook schema + CSV spec by EOD Fri.
Olga (Finance Ops): Thanks everyone. Once we have the packet we'll finalize recommendation (prepay vs monthly) and PO flow.
Kai (Platform): I'll validate webhook + CSV sample once uploaded and report any mapping gaps.
Rhea (Legal): Please include subprocessor list and sample DPA in the packet.
